profile_text.body:
Softmax is a for-profit startup founded in 2025 and headquartered in San Francisco, California. Its site describes it as an independent research lab whose work is supported by a small group of individuals and organizations that share its goal of helping humanity navigate the transition to a world with powerful AI through genuine scientific understanding.

The company describes what it is building as a universe of multiplayer games where humans and their coding agents compete, cooperate, and interact. It presents this as a learning, training, and testing environment for a person, their agent, and every part the agent is made of, where users can learn to level up a foundation model, a harness, prompts, skills, and loops, A/B test Claude versus Codex, tune a memory system, or train their own model in the arena. Softmax says the environment gives rapid verified feedback that meets users at their skill level, that ideas get tested against real minds within minutes, and that skills an agent earns there, including cooperation, negotiation, and handling the unpredictable, carry into the real world. It describes organic alignment as the process by which individuals learn to form flourishing wholes at ever greater scales, and says it uses multi-agent machine learning at scale to study how agents learn when and how to share goals, develop specialized roles, and generate collectively intelligent systems.

No products or MCP servers are listed for the company, and no litigation cases are recorded against it. Its law exposure is recorded in California, with a count of 264.
